sources.title: ATO: General interest charge (GIC) rates
sources.fact: Read by an agent on 24 September 2026 (page last updated 4 September 2026); not yet reviewed by a person. GIC annual and daily rates: October to December 2026 11.51% (0.03153425%); July to September 2026 11.43% (0.03131507%); April to June 2026 10.96% (0.03002740%). Section 8AAD of the Taxation Administration Act 1953 specifies how the rate is calculated; the daily rate is the annual rate divided by the days in the calendar year. Rates for the next quarter are generally announced 2 weeks before it starts.
sources.limitations: Quarterly rates change. Verify the rate for each day of the period at use time.

sources.title: ATO: Penalty units
sources.fact: Read by an agent on 24 September 2026 (page last updated 26 June 2026); not yet reviewed by a person. Penalty unit amount by date the infringement occurred: $364 on or after 1 July 2026; $330 from 7 November 2024 to 30 June 2026; $313 from 1 July 2023 to 6 November 2024. Penalties are not deductible.
sources.limitations: Verify the value for the infringement date at use time.

sources.title: ATO: Failure to lodge on time penalty
sources.fact: Read by an agent on 24 September 2026 (page last updated 22 June 2026); not yet reviewed by a person. Base penalty: one penalty unit for every 28 days or part thereof that the document is overdue, up to 5 penalty units, for individuals and small withholders. Multiplied by 2 for a medium withholder, 5 for a large withholder and 500 for a significant global entity, tested in the month the document was due. Generally no penalty notice for a late return or activity statement that results in a refund or nil, with stated exceptions. Remission criteria and the registered agent safe harbour are set out on the page.
sources.limitations: Verify the complete page, the withholder definitions and PS LA 2011/19 at use time.
